site.name: Eren
site.headline: Building web tools, Android ROM utilities, and small mods.
site.subheadline: I am Eren, a student and developer exploring modern web applications, Python scripts, game mods, and AOSP development.
site.contactPrompt: Open to interesting software projects, web tools, and collaborations.

about.lead: I enjoy building practical web apps, Android build tools, and lightweight mods for games I play.
paragraphs: I am a student learning web development, Python, and AOSP. Most of my projects start from something I want to use myself, whether that is managing S3-compatible object storage buckets, benchmarking Android ROM builds, or fixing small annoyances in games.

On the web side, I work mostly with Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Prisma. Outside the browser, I experiment with Java mods for Minecraft, C# plugins for Spaceflight Simulator, and shell automation for AOSP and kernel builds.

works.title: Vulkan Mailbox Fix
works.summary: Client-side Minecraft 26.2+ mod for Fabric and NeoForge that fixes FPS getting capped to monitor refresh rate on Linux Wayland with Vulkan (MC-307719).
works.description: Raises the Vulkan MAILBOX swapchain image count from 3 to 4, clamped to the driver's supported maximum, so hybrid-GPU Wayland setups can run uncapped without screen tearing when VSync is off.

works.title: Backrooms 96K
works.summary: Endless first-person Backrooms walking simulator in no_std Rust and raw OpenGL, packed into a single native executable under 96 KiB.
works.description: Built with zero Cargo dependencies for Linux and Windows x86-64. Every wall, texture, shader, bitmap font glyph, and ALSA or WinMM sound effect is generated procedurally in code, featuring an infinite chunked maze, VHS camcorder HUD, and dynamic lighting.

works.title: gcp-bucket-nextjs
works.summary: Next.js application to upload, search, and download files directly through an S3-compatible object storage bucket.
works.description: Powers a monospace-themed ROM-hosting site and file catalog backed by S3-compatible object storage, with variant filters, upload management, and direct file downloads.

works.title: aosp-build-times
works.summary: Web dashboard for recording, searching, and comparing Android ROM compilation times across server specs.
works.description: Built with Next.js 16 and Prisma Postgres to track clean and dirty build durations, hosting specs, and searchable community submissions.

works.title: ScrollFly
works.summary: Minecraft mod for Fabric and Forge that brings Spectator mode scroll wheel flight speed adjustment into Creative mode.
works.description: Lets players speed up or slow down cleanly while flying in Creative mode using the mouse wheel, complete with a toggle keybind to switch back to hotbar scrolling.

works.title: MapDistanceFix
works.summary: Minecraft Fabric mod for 1.20.1 and newer that keeps player position and facing direction visible beyond map boundaries.
works.description: Replaces generic boundary dot icons with directional player markers for Minecraft 1.20.1+ so navigating treasure maps and distant regions stays intuitive.

works.title: SolarFuelMod
works.summary: Lightweight Spaceflight Simulator mod that lets solar panels generate liquid fuel.
works.description: Written in C# with Harmony patches to extend solar panel behavior in Spaceflight Simulator without modifying core game assemblies.

works.title: BerryMuch
works.summary: Minecraft Fabric mod that aligns berry and melon slice nutrition with their textures and includes a reloadable JSON config.
works.description: Adjusts Sweet Berries, Glow Berries, and Melon Slices so hunger and saturation match visual portions, with customizable food values via config file and reload command.

works.title: Scripts
works.summary: Shell scripts to automate AOSP environment setup and Android kernel compilation workflows.
works.description: Includes kranul-build.sh supporting multiple compilers, KernelSU, and Telegram announcements, alongside setup-aosp-environment.sh for installing packages and configuring ccache.
